entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: A plane reminiscent of sengoku-era Japan with two symbiotic worlds, the material utsushiyo and the kami spirit realm kakuriyo.

entities.name: The Kami
entities.description: Divine spirits worshipped by Kamigawa's people who began to take form in the material world and attacked.

entities.name: Takeshi Konda
entities.description: The proud daimyo and most powerful warlord, who ruled the Towabara Plains from Eiganjo and secretly began the war.

entities.name: Reito
entities.description: A town a few miles from Eiganjo Castle, attacked by the kami.

entities.name: The Kami War
entities.description: The war begun when kami set upon Reito, lasting twenty years as spirits ravaged the plains.

entities.name: The moonfolk
entities.description: Allies who helped Konda kidnap a kami.

entities.name: O-Kagachi
entities.description: The great kami of all things, outraged by Konda's kidnapping.

entities.name: Michiko
entities.description: Konda's daughter, one of two with hope of placating the kami.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: A stolen kami who calls herself Kyodai, with hope of restoring peace.

events.summary: The kami begin to take form in the material world while Konda's armies secure territory.
events.quote: Even as his armies and samurai secured more territory in Konda's name, the kami manifested in ever-greater numbers.

events.summary: The kami set upon the town of Reito, killing nearly every living thing, and the Kami War begins.
events.quote: A few miles from Eiganjo Castle, the kami set upon the town of Reito.

events.summary: Konda remains mysteriously safe within his stronghold throughout the siege.
events.quote: Throughout this siege, Konda remained within his stronghold, mysteriously safe from harm.

events.summary: It is revealed that Konda began the war by kidnapping a kami, with moonfolk aid, to secure his own power and immortality.
events.quote: With aid from moonfolk allies, Konda kidnapped a kami to secure his own power and immortality.

events.summary: The kidnapping outrages O-Kagachi, igniting an ire that claims countless lives.
events.quote: This outraged the great O-Kagachi, kami of all things, igniting an ire that would claim countless lives.
